item.title: 2 earthquakes in Venezuela kill at least 164. And, Trump cancels housing bill signing
item.description: Two major earthquakes in Venezuela have killed at least 164 people and left hundreds injured. And, President Trump canceled the signing of a massive bipartisan housing bill yesterday.
item.content:encoded:
Two major earthquakes in Venezuela have killed at least 164 people and left hundreds injured. And, President Trump canceled the signing of a massive bipartisan housing bill yesterday.

item.title: 'They can kill you': Immigrants fear a surge in xenophobic violence in South Africa
item.description: Foreign-owned businesses have been attacked, migrants driven from their homes, and several killed. A leading xenophobic group has given all undocumented immigrants until June 30 to leave the country.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The death toll is rising after major Venezuelan earthquakes topple many buildings
item.description: The National Assembly president put the latest toll at 188 dead, 1,520 injured and 157 reported missing. He said teams are racing to rescue hundreds of people still trapped in damaged buildings.

item.title: Greetings from sweltering Switzerland
item.description: On the waterfront in Lucerne, Switzerland, soccer fans watched jumbo TVs showing a World Cup match played an ocean away. But the air felt more like the tropics.

item.title: U.N. nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran, but Iran says only after final deal
item.description: The head of the U.N.'s atomic agency said Iran's nuclear enrichment sites would be inspected as part of the interim deal. Iran insists any such visit would only come after a final deal.
